findings.summary: The Save affordance now requires a nonblank birthday as a precondition, which contradicts the birthday being optional everywhere else in the change.
findings.evidence: preconditions: [Owner session, Nonblank name, Nonblank birthday] vs. BirthdayField 'Optional birthday as month and day', C.webapp.contact.save 'an optional month-day birthday', and J.contacts/s3 'optional birthday'

findings.summary: The birthday field is typed local-date, a full calendar date, but the UI and criterion define it as month-day with an optional year, so a yearless birthday cannot be stored.
findings.evidence: entity.ContactRecord: '{ name: birthday, type: local-date, optional: true }' vs. BirthdayField: 'Optional birthday as month and day; the year may be left blank'

findings.summary: The criterion now requires validating the birthday, but operation.contact.save, which is the operation that persists the record, was not updated to define any birthday validation or failure.
findings.evidence: C.webapp.contact.save: 'Validates nonblank name and an optional month-day birthday' while operation.contact.save preconditions remain [Owner session, Nonblank name] with no birthday validation failure listed
